import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int INF = 10000000;
    static final int N = 210;
    static final int M = 21000;

    static class Edge {
        int v, w;
        Edge(int v, int w) {
            this.v = v;
            this.w = w;
        }
    }

    static Edge[] edges = new Edge[M];
    static int[] nxtEdge = new int[M];
    static int[] firstEdge = new int[N];
    static int edgeCnt;

    static void addEdge(int u, int v, int w) {
        edges[edgeCnt] = new Edge(v, w);
        nxtEdge[edgeCnt] = firstEdge[u];
        firstEdge[u] = edgeCnt++;
        edges[edgeCnt] = new Edge(u, 0);
        nxtEdge[edgeCnt] = firstEdge[v];
        firstEdge[v] = edgeCnt++;
    }

    static int S, T;
    static int[] dist = new int[N];
    static int[] q = new int[N*2];
    static int[] curEdge = new int[N];
    static int[] gap = new int[N];
    static int[] inQueue = new int[N];
    static int[] parent = new int[N];

    static int dinicSAP(int s, int t) {
        Arrays.fill(curEdge, -1);
        Arrays.fill(parent, -1);
        Arrays.fill(inQueue, 0);
        Arrays.fill(gap, 0);
        Arrays.fill(dist, 0);

        int qf = 0, qr = 0;
        q[qr++] = t;
        inQueue[t] = 1;
        gap[0]++;
        dist[t] = 0;

        while (qf < qr) {
            int u = q[qf++];
            for (int i = firstEdge[u]; i != -1; i = nxtEdge[i]) {
                int v = edges[i].v;
                if (inQueue[v] == 0) {
                    q[qr++] = v;
                    inQueue[v] = 1;
                    dist[v] = dist[u] + 1;
                    gap[dist[v]]++;
                    curEdge[v] = firstEdge[v];
                }
            }
        }

        int low = INF, u = s, ans = 0;
        parent[s] = s;

        while (dist[s] < t) {
            boolean flag = false;
            int i = curEdge[u];
            while (i != -1) {
                if (edges[i].w != 0 && dist[edges[i].v] + 1 == dist[u]) {
                    flag = true;
                    low = Math.min(low, edges[i].w);
                    parent[edges[i].v] = u;
                    u = edges[i].v;
                    if (u == t) {
                        while (u != s) {
                            u = parent[u];
                            edges[curEdge[u]].w -= low;
                            edges[curEdge[u] ^ 1].w += low;
                        }
                        ans += low;
                        low = INF;
                    }
                    break;
                }
                i = nxtEdge[i];
            }
            curEdge[u] = i;
            if (flag) continue;

            int mindis = t + 1;
            for (int j = firstEdge[u]; j != -1; j = nxtEdge[j]) {
                if (edges[j].w != 0 && mindis > dist[edges[j].v]) {
                    mindis = dist[edges[j].v];
                    curEdge[u] = j;
                }
            }
            gap[dist[u]]--;
            if (gap[dist[u]] == 0) return ans;
            dist[u] = mindis + 1;
            gap[dist[u]]++;
            u = parent[u];
        }
        return ans;
    }

    static char[][] grid1 = new char[12][12];
    static char[][] grid2 = new char[12][12];
    static int[][] sci = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] ca = new int[12][12];
    static int[][][] rock = new int[62][12][12];
    static int[][][][][] reach = new int[62][12][12][12][12];
    static int[][] vis = new int[12][12];
    static int[][] dir = {{-1,0},{1,0},{0,-1},{0,1}};
    static int n, timeLimit;

    static void readInput() {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextInt();
        timeLimit = sc.nextInt();
        sc.nextLine();
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                grid1[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (grid1[i][j] == 'Z') rock[0][i][j] = 2;
                else if (grid1[i][j] == 'Y') rock[0][i][j] = 1;
                else sci[i][j] = grid1[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
            String line = sc.nextLine();
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                grid2[i][j] = line.charAt(j-1);
                if (grid2[i][j] >= '0' && grid2[i][j] <= '9')
                    ca[i][j] = grid2[i][j] - '0';
            }
        }
    }

    static void expandStones() {
        for (int k = 1; k <= timeLimit; ++k) {
            for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i) {
                for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j) {
                    if (rock[k-1][i][j] == 1) {
                        rock[k][i][j] = 1;
                    } else if (rock[k-1][i][j] == 2) {
                        rock[k][i][j] = 2;
                    } else {
                        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
                            int nx = i + dir[z][0];
                            int ny = j + dir[z][1];
                            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n) {
                                if (rock[k-1][nx][ny] == 2) {
                                    rock[k][i][j] = 2;
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void searchPath(int x, int y, int nowx, int nowy, int k) {
        vis[nowx][nowy] = 1;
        reach[k][x][y][nowx][nowy] = 1;
        if (k >= timeLimit || rock[k][nowx][nowy] != 0) return;
        for (int z = 0; z < 4; ++z) {
            int nx = nowx + dir[z][0];
            int ny = nowy + dir[z][1];
            if (nx >= 1 && nx <= n && ny >= 1 && ny <= n && vis[nx][ny] == 0) {
                if (rock[k][nx][ny] != 0) continue;
                searchPath(x, y, nx, ny, k + 1);
            }
        }
    }

    static void computeReach() {
        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                if (sci[i][j] != 0) {
                    for (int a = 0; a < 12; a++) Arrays.fill(vis[a], 0);
                    searchPath(i, j, i, j, 0);
                }

        for (int k = 1; k <= timeLimit; ++k)
            for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
                for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                    for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx)
                        for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny)
                            reach[k][x][y][nx][ny] += reach[k-1][x][y][nx][ny];
    }

    static void buildNetwork() {
        S = 0;
        T = n * n * 2 + 1;
        Arrays.fill(firstEdge, -1);
        edgeCnt = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                addEdge(S, (i-1)*n + j, sci[i][j]);

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; ++i)
            for (int j = 1; j <= n; ++j)
                addEdge(n*n + (i-1)*n + j, T, ca[i][j]);

        for (int x = 1; x <= n; ++x)
            for (int y = 1; y <= n; ++y)
                for (int nx = 1; nx <= n; ++nx)
                    for (int ny = 1; ny <= n; ++ny)
                        if (sci[x][y] != 0 && ca[nx][ny] != 0) {
                            if (reach[timeLimit][x][y][nx][ny] != 0)
                                addEdge((x-1)*n + y, n*n + (nx-1)*n + ny, INF);
                        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        readInput();
        expandStones();
        computeReach();
        buildNetwork();

        int ans = dinicSAP(S, T);
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
}
